mowing.title: 2026 season, retrospective
mowing.definition: Parcels with at least one 'Grass Maint' cut in the forestry ledger between 1 Apr and 30 Sep 2026 (the rotation). Gap = longest stretch between consecutive cuts, or from the last cut to 30 Sep. Flag: more than 90 days, about one and a half of the city's own observed cycles (median longest gap between cuts 54 days); BUILD-SPEC's 42-day threshold flags almost every lot because the rotation itself runs about eight weeks. Posting dates are batched weekly, so gaps are good to about a week. Ward from the LRA inventory or a matched 311 request; blank where neither exists.
